::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Feb 15th 1894  
**From:** [G F S](organizations/other_23.qmd) Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

Dear [Mrs Egerton](people/person_470.qmd)
Unluckily the matter of the Grants could not come on till the last and I never found you again. I am sorry to say that the Council refused to forward your application as it would be a dangerous precedent to other Branches who might ask for the same grant. I have written to [Mrs Chester](people/person_1682.qmd) and she may send it to you. I am sorry I had to run away from you, but there was need of my seeing [Miss Chambers](people/person_2133.qmd) and I hoped you would have spoken when the subject came on.

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** In matching envelope with G F S written in upper left corner and stamp removed, addressed ‘Mrs Egerton/The Cottage/Alresford.’
